Diagnosis:
CAUSE: Pod shop/payments-5bc47dccd9-n6ljs is not ready because the NetworkPolicy `deny-all` in namespace shop denies all egress, so its readiness probe `nslookup kubernetes.default.svc.cluster.local` cannot reach DNS and times out.
EVIDENCE:
1. Pod shop/payments-5bc47dccd9-n6ljs: phase Running, ready 0/1, restarts 0, node sre-lab-worker2, IP 10.244.2.79. The container did not crash. (diag-k8s, kube get pod, namespace shop)
2. Describe: Ready False and ContainersReady False. Readiness is `exec [nslookup kubernetes.default.svc.cluster.local] delay=0s timeout=5s period=10s #success=1 #failure=2`. Events: Warning Unhealthy "Readiness probe failed: command timed out: \"nslookup kubernetes.default.svc.cluster.local\" timed out after 5s". (diag-k8s, kube describe pod)
3. Namespace shop events (warnings only), re-checked by me: reason Unhealthy, count 15, object Pod/payments-5bc47dccd9-n6ljs, same nslookup timeout message. The same probe timeout also appears on sibling Pod/payments-5bc47dccd9-hxf47 (count 17). (my kube events call, namespace shop, warnings_only true)
4. Pod logs (tail 50): the only line is "payments up", so the application runs and only the probe fails. (diag-k8s, kube logs pod payments-5bc47dccd9-n6ljs)
5. NetworkPolicy shop/deny-all, re-checked by me: podSelector {} (all pods in shop), policyTypes ["Egress"], no egress rules, label lab/scenario=netpol. Egress is denied for every pod, including DNS on port 53. (my kube get networkpolicy raw, namespace shop; diag-k8s ran the same read)
6. Deployment payments in shop, revision 1 per diag-k8s: readinessProbe exec nslookup with failureThreshold 2, periodSeconds 10, timeoutSeconds 5. Condition Available False, reason MinimumReplicasUnavailable, 1 unavailable replica. (diag-k8s, kube get deployment raw, namespace shop)
7. No ImagePull, secret or OOM event for this pod in the namespace events. (diag-k8s, kube events warnings_only, namespace shop; my check agrees)
FIX (not applied): add an egress allow rule for DNS (UDP and TCP port 53 to the kube-dns pods in kube-system) to the `deny-all` NetworkPolicy in namespace shop, or delete `deny-all` if it is not wanted.

Fact.Name: cause
Fact.Value: NetworkPolicy `deny-all` (`podSelector: {}`, `policyTypes: [Egress]`, no egress rule) blocks DNS, 53/UDP to kube-dns
